Inclusion Criteria:
Persons with
  -  stroke  [OR] / cerebrovascular disease
  -  traumatic brain injury
  -  multiple sclerosis
  -  spinal cord injuries (including spinal cord lesions i

Exclusion Criteria:
Persons with
  -  heterotopic ossifications,
  -  chronic administration of drugs, which promote fat increase
  -  chronic administration of drugs, which promote bone  [OR] or muscle loss
  -  co-existing other diseases such as: endocrinopathies, [OR]  muscular dystrophies, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
